scope: Additive TH18 Electro Titan L1-L5 direct-parent aura baseline.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: Confirms Electro Titan level 5 at TH18, but publishes no values or aura timing/geometry.

sources.title: Electro Titan — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports L1-L5 HP/DPS, housing, 1.25 range, 1.5 cadence and ground-and-air targets. It qualitatively describes the aura but not its exact pulse values or ordering.

sources.title: Electro Titan
sources.limitations: The frozen post-freeze audit records its 3.5-tile, 0.4-second, ground-and-air aura, Wall exclusion and Rage/Freeze exceptions; first pulse, boundaries, hidden/underground treatment and ordering are not published.

support.note: The source-backed L1-L5 parent and existing shared periodic aura path are explicitly covered through Core, Headless, Viewer and RL.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines first-pulse timing, hitbox boundary, hidden or underground recipient treatment, aura stacking, concurrent action ordering, target ties, collision or visual timing.
Exact L1-L5 values and aura mechanics are secondary except for the official TH18 L5 availability.
conclusion: Electro Titan L1-L5 shares the existing periodic aura Core route; source values and exceptions are current-delta validated, while pulse geometry and timing remain partial.
